title: A Closer Look - ADSB Parachute Packing
description: In this final episode of A Closer Look Season 2, we find ourselves at Aerial Delivery Support Bay (ADSB) once more. This time we learn how to pack one of the parachutes used in the night drop episode. It's amazing how something so big can fit in to the considerable small pack it's deployed from. Join us one more time as we take A Closer Look...
